propositions: Four rendered non-bridge advanced parser factories (metrics, audit, bridge-fsck, bridge-probe) use stock argparse.HelpFormatter instead of RebarHelpFormatter, creating width inconsistency (78 vs 80) and leaving them vulnerable to py3.13 argparse help-rendering divergences that would silently stale committed artifacts.

RebarHelpFormatter pins width to 80 and overrides _format_action_invocation and _format_usage to handle py3.13 metavar and usage-wrapping divergences, but only bridge was switched in S2d; the other four remain unpinned.

Contract test must verify that all help-backed (non-intercept, non-hidden, non-retired) registered parser factories use a formatter subclassing RebarHelpFormatter, catching any future reintroduction of bare argparse.HelpFormatter in rendered routes.

Switching the four factories to RebarHelpFormatter and regenerating artifacts yields deterministic, byte-identical help across py3.11/3.12/3.13, with only wrapping changes (width 78→80) in bridge-fsck.txt and docs/cli-reference.md; metrics/audit/bridge-probe help unchanged.
